```{r}
# spatial data science
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(units)


# Data
library(AOI)
library(readr)

# Visualization
library(gghighlight)
library(ggrepel)
library(knitr)
library(flextable)
```

## Question 1

```{r}
##remotes::install_github("mikejohnson51/AOI")
##remotes::install_github("ropensci/USAboundaries")
##remotes::install_github("ropensci/USAboundariesData")
##remotes::install_github("ropenscilabs/rnaturalearthdata")

eqdc <- '+proj=eqdc +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-96 +lat_1=20 +lat_2=60 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs'

aoi_get(country = c("MX", "CA", "USA"))

eqdc <- st_crs(5070)

#USA state boundaries
countries <- rnaturalearth::countries110 |>
  st_transform(eqdc)

states <- USAboundaries::us_states(resolution = "low") |>
  filter(!state_abbr %in% c("HI", "AK", "PR")) |>
  st_transform(eqdc)

#get data
cities <- read_csv("data/uscities.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(eqdc)

```

## Question 2

```{r}
#outputs as a flextable

#2.1 City Dist to US border
unionedstates <- st_union(states)

USboundary <- st_boundary(unionedstates) |> 
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")
plot(USboundary, col = "red")

cities$dist2USborder <- drop_units(set_units(st_distance(cities, USboundary), "km"))

farthest5cities2USborder <- cities |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(city, state_name, dist2USborder) |>
  arrange(desc(dist2USborder)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)

FT1 <- flextable(farthest5cities2USborder)
print(FT1)

#2.2 Dist to States
all_state_boundaries <- states |> 
  st_boundary() |>
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

#remove the outerUSA line
state_borders <- st_difference(all_state_boundaries, USboundary)

#compute 
cities$dist2stateborder <- apply(st_distance(cities, state_borders), 1, min) |>
  units::set_units("km") |> 
  as.numeric()

farthest5_stateborder <- cities |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(city, state_name, dist2stateborder) |>
  arrange(desc(dist2stateborder)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)

FT2 <- flextable(farthest5_stateborder)
print(FT2)

#distance to Mexico
mexico <- countries |> 
  filter(SOVEREIGNT == "Mexico")

mex_border <- st_boundary(mexico) |> 
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

#full distance the find
cities$dist2MexBorder <- apply(st_distance(cities, mex_border), 1, min) |>
  units::set_units("km") |>
  as.numeric()

farthest5cities2MexBorder <- cities |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(city, state_name, dist2MexBorder) |>
  arrange(desc(dist2MexBorder)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)

FT3 <- flextable(farthest5cities2MexBorder)
print(FT3)

#2.4 Dist to Canada border
canada <- countries |> 
  filter(SOVEREIGNT == "Canada")

can_border <- st_boundary(canada) |> 
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

#again
cities$dist2CanBorder <- apply(st_distance(cities, can_border), 1, min) |>
  units::set_units("km") |>
  as.numeric()

farthest5cities2CanBorder <- cities |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(city, state_name, dist2CanBorder) |>
  arrange(desc(dist2CanBorder)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)

FT4 <- flextable(farthest5cities2CanBorder)
print(FT4)


```

## Question 3

```{r}
## Question 3
# 3.1 Data
three_countries <- countries |>
  filter(SOVEREIGNT %in% c("United States of America", "Canada", "Mexico"))
conus_outline <- st_boundary(st_union(states)) |> st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")
state_lines   <- states |> st_boundary() |> st_combine() |> st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")
top10_cities  <- cities |> arrange(desc(population)) |> slice_head(n = 10)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = three_countries, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = conus_outline,    fill = NA, lty = "dashed", size = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = state_lines,      fill = NA, lty = "solid",  size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = top10_cities, aes(size = population), color = "red") +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = top10_cities |> 
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      bind_cols(as_tibble(st_coordinates(top10_cities)) |> set_names(c("X","Y"))),
    aes(x = X, y = Y, label = city),
    size = 3, min.segment.length = 0) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 5)) +
  labs(title = "US + 3 Countries + Top 10 US Cities") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3.2 City Distance from the border
farthest5_US <- cities |> semi_join(farthest5cities2USborder, by = c("city","state_name"))
farthest5_US_df <- farthest5_US |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  bind_cols(as_tibble(st_coordinates(farthest5_US)) |> set_names(c("X","Y")))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "grey70") +
  geom_sf(data = cities, aes(color = dist2USborder), size = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "km") +
  geom_sf(data = farthest5_US, color = "blue", size = 2) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = farthest5_US_df,
    aes(x = X, y = Y, label = city),
    size = 3, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Cities by Distance to US Border") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3.3 City Distance to Nearest State
farthest5_state <- cities |> semi_join(farthest5_stateborder, by = c("city","state_name"))
farthest5_state_df <- farthest5_state |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  bind_cols(as_tibble(st_coordinates(farthest5_state)) |> set_names(c("X","Y")))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "grey70") +
  geom_sf(data = cities, aes(color = dist2stateborder), size = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "km") +
  geom_sf(data = farthest5_state, color = "darkgreen", size = 2) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = farthest5_state_df,
    aes(x = X, y = Y, label = city),
    size = 3, color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Cities by Distance to Nearest State Border") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3.4 Equidistance boundary from mexico and canada
cities <- cities |>
  mutate(diffMexCan = abs(dist2MexBorder - dist2CanBorder))

zone100   <- cities |> filter(diffMexCan <= 100)
top5_zone <- zone100 |>
  arrange(desc(population)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)
top5_zone_df <- top5_zone |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  bind_cols(as_tibble(st_coordinates(top5_zone)) |> set_names(c("X","Y")))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "grey70") +
  geom_sf(data = cities, aes(color = diffMexCan), size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Mexico–Canada (km)") +
  geom_sf(
    data = zone100,
    color = "red",
    size = 1.5,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "white",
    stroke = 1) + geom_label_repel(data = top5_zone_df,
    aes(x = X, y = Y, label = city),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf) +
  labs(title = "Cities Within 100 km of Equidistant Mexico/Canada") +
  ggthemes::theme_map()

```

## Question 4

```{r}
# 4.1 Quantifying Border Zone

#dataset of cities within 100 miles/160km
cities_borderzone <- cities |>
  filter(dist2USborder <= 160)

#number of cities
n_cities_borderzone <- nrow(cities_borderzone)

#total population within 100-mile zone
population_borderzone <- sum(cities_borderzone$population, na.rm = TRUE)

#total pop allcities
population_total <- sum(cities$population, na.rm = TRUE)

# Percentage pop in zone
percent_population_borderzone <- (population_borderzone / population_total) * 100

#table
borderzone_summary <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Number of cities in 100-mile zone",
    "Pop in 100-mile zone",
    "Total pop",
    "Percentage of population in the zone"),
  Value = c(
    n_cities_borderzone,
    population_borderzone,
    population_total,
    paste0(round(percent_population_borderzone, 1), "%")))

#flextable
FT4_1 <- flextable(borderzone_summary)
FT4_1


# 4.2 Mapping Border Zone

#10 most populous cities withi Danger Zone
top10_dangerzone <- cities_borderzone |>
  arrange(desc(population)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

#coords for labeling
top10_dangerzone_df <- top10_dangerzone |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  bind_cols(as_tibble(st_coordinates(top10_dangerzone)) |> set_names(c("X", "Y")))

#map
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "grey70") +
  geom_sf(data = cities, aes(color = dist2USborder), size = 0.7) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "orange", high = "darkred", name = "Distance to the Border (km)") +
  gghighlight(
    dist2USborder <= 160,
    use_group_by = FALSE,
    unhighlighted_params = list(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.5)) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = top10_dangerzone_df,
    aes(x = X, y = Y, label = city),
    size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Cities Within 100-mile Border-Zone") +
  theme_minimal()


# 4.3 Most populous city per state

#find the most populous city within the 100-mile zone
top_city_each_state <- cities_borderzone |>
  group_by(state_name) |>
  slice_max(population, n = 1) |>
  ungroup()

#coordinates for labeling
top_city_each_state_df <- top_city_each_state |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  bind_cols(as_tibble(st_coordinates(top_city_each_state)) |> set_names(c("X", "Y")))

# map
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "grey70") +
  geom_sf(data = cities, aes(color = dist2USborder), size = 0.7) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "orange", high = "darkred", name = "Distance to Border (km)") +
  gghighlight(
    dist2USborder <= 160,
    use_group_by = FALSE,
    unhighlighted_params = list(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.5)) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = top_city_each_state_df,
    aes(x = X, y = Y, label = city),
    size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Most Populous City by State within the Border Zone") +
  theme_minimal()

```
